Leah (marketing): Hey eng-runtime — we need a fast sanity + benchmark rerun for the launch story and a short heatmap for the webinar. Target: p50/p95 latency for text-gen and embed flows, coldstart vs warmup. Can you run a minimal sweep this week? I can provide payloads and the prompt set.

Tomas (eng-runtime): On it. Quick clarifying Qs: which model(s) do you want measured (open vs rlhf), token lengths to target, and do we need streaming vs non-streaming paths? Also: include quantized variants (8-bit) or just FP16?

Leah (marketing): Thanks — primary focus is on our curated open model (aligned v1) + a quantized 8-bit variant. Please include streaming and non-streaming so we can show differences in the webinar. Use three sequence lengths: short (32 tokens), med (256), long (1024).

Tomas (eng-runtime): Got it. Do you want prefix/KV cache warmup simulated (i.e., repeated requests to measure steady-state) vs true coldstart (single request after model load)? We'll produce both. Also: do you need request-level traces for the p95 breakdown (kernel wait, enqueue time, decode)?

Leah (marketing): Yes — both warmup (10 repeating requests per worker) and coldstart snapshots. Traces would be fantastic for the slide calling out bottlenecks. Also, we need a small artifact bundle (raw latencies, token counts, config used) we can hand to legal for claims.

Priya (eng-runtime): Note — autoscaling/burst policy can skew tail numbers if we run in shared pool. If you want deterministic p95 for marketing claims, we should run on a short reserved pool (2x reserved workers) or Dedicated patch. Can marketing cover the smoke reserved slot for a 2-hour window?

Leah (marketing): We can reserve a short window. Budget OK for a 2-hour reserved run. Please send ETA and any run-time knobs you need us to pin (batch size, warmup tokens, placement).

Tomas (eng-runtime): Cool — tentative run tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT. Will pin batch_size=8, max_tokens=2048, warmup=10, quantize=8bit. We'll run: open-curated-v1 fp16, open-curated-v1 8bit, and an RLHF comparable variant for baseline. Will include streaming/non-streaming and both cold/warm snapshots.

Sam (eng-ml): Also attach the eval prompt set (public link) so we measure quality regressions: https://internal.redwood/evals/launch-promptset-v3 — include a small BLEU/ROUGE pass for the 256 token cases so comms can back up claims.

Leah (marketing): Perfect. Please also capture the warmup heatmap (percentiles across sequence lengths) and a short note on methodology (how many samples, seed, any randomization). Legal needs reproducible steps.

Tomas (eng-runtime): Will produce a runbook snippet and the artifact bundle (CSV + JSONL + run-config). We'll seed RNG and pin model commits. Quick ask: do you want ground-truth “cold” server boot (empty cache + container start) or just model-load cold (already provisioned infra)? True server boot takes longer and is less repeatable.

Leah (marketing): Model-load cold is fine. We want conservative numbers but not the whole infra boot.

bench-bot: Job queued: bench-2026-0310-043 (priority: marketing-smoke). ETA: results in ~2.5h after run completion.

Tomas (eng-runtime): FYI, I'll make two artefacts: 1) short slide-ready CSV (p50/p90/p95, medians per seq length, streaming vs non) and 2) raw dump + runbook. Will annotate any spots where autoscaler interfered.

Leah (marketing): Amazing — last ask: can you include a 1-paragraph neutral blurb we can use in the press deck that highlights latency and cost tradeoffs without naming competitor numbers? Example: 'Under typical web-chat workloads, our tuned runtime achieves median latency of ~XX ms and predictable tail behaviors via prefix caching and warm pools.' Just a neutral line we can tweak.

Priya (eng-runtime): I'll draft that line after seeing p95.

Tomas (eng-runtime): Quick payload example for the run (use this exact body for reproducibility):

```
POST /v1/generate
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "open-curated-v1",
  "input": "Summarize the following text in one sentence.",
  "max_tokens": 256,
  "stream": false
}
```

Tomas (eng-runtime): Also we'll include a short snippet for streaming measurement using SSE and measure token-level latency.

Leah (marketing): Great — thanks team. Please ping here with the run artifact link and the one-paragraph blurb. :thumbsup:

Tomas (eng-runtime): Will do. Tagging @Priya to confirm reserved slot and @Sam for eval pass.

Priya (eng-runtime): Reserved slot confirmed. I'll monitor autoscaler.

bench-bot: Job started: bench-2026-0310-043. Running suites: {short,med,long} x {streaming,non-streaming} x {fp16,8bit} — collecting p50/p90/p95, token counts, and traces.

Tomas (eng-runtime): When results are in I'll upload CSV + raw JSONL to /artifacts/marketing/bench-2723456789 and post link here.

Leah (marketing): Thanks all — excited to get heatmap and a slide-ready CSV for the webinar."
